entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: One of Zendikar's seven continents, a steep-walled plateau drawing ships to its shores.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane on which Murasa lies.

entities.name: Makindi Empire
entities.description: The ancient empire that once held Murasa.

entities.name: Lorthos
entities.description: A sea monster, or its ancestor, that dragged the Murasa Skyclave into the sea.

entities.name: Murasa Skyclave
entities.description: A floating ruin of an ancient fortress toppled by Lorthos and since risen again.

entities.name: Kazuul
entities.description: An ogre slavemaster who controls the Cliffs of Kazuul and its mines.

entities.name: Tajuru
entities.description: Elves whose capital is the Tumbled Palace.

entities.name: Tumbled Palace
entities.description: The Tajuru capital perched over a jurworrel tree, harboring remnants of Eldrazi corruption.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker who destroyed the Singing City with the Lithoform Core.

entities.name: Singing City
entities.description: A pre-Eldrazi kor-built maze on the Na Plateau, destroyed by Nissa.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: Kor herders of the Pillar Plains who were massacred in 4537 AR.

entities.name: Talib
entities.description: The kor god of the earth, depicted in the statue atop the Living Spire.

entities.name: Visimal
entities.description: An ancient diamond-shaped structure where vampires have lived for ages.

entities.name: Kazandu
entities.description: A vast collapsed region of canyons and jaddi trees.

events.summary: A sea monster, perhaps Lorthos, drags the Murasa Skyclave into the sea, ending the Makindi reign.
events.quote: dragged the Murasa Skyclave into the sea

events.summary: The kor herders of the Pillar Plains are massacred in 4537 and their bodies hung over Thunder Gap.
Nissa destroys the Singing City on the Na Plateau with the Lithoform Core.
events.quote: It was destroyed when Nissa used the Lithoform Core .
